Author: Sayuuryi
Name: Sawoo Boss Scaler
Description: Pick a size for every boss in every phase of the ultimate fights. Type /sbs to open it.
Punchline: Change the size of ultimate bosses, phase by phase.
Changelog:
### Settings
- Resize my target: try a size on any enemy, a striking dummy works, to check which size method works for you

### Fixes
- Bosses are put back to normal size when they stop being resized while still on the field
- The plugin still loads if enemy actions can't be read after a game patch; phases then follow casts and bosses showing up
- Putting bosses back when unloading is done on the game's thread

Author: Sayuuryi
Name: Sawoo Plates
Description: Adds a small menu bar to the Portrait Editor with preset codes, a preset library and finer camera controls.
Punchline: A few extra tools for the Portrait Editor.
Changelog:
### Plate design
- Use plate design (was Apply plate design) opens Edit Plate on your plate and shows a list next to it with what to pick in each row, marking parts you don't have
- Ctrl+click still lets you pick which parts to use; rows you leave out say "Keep yours"
- Closing Edit Plate closes the plate it opened and brings the Sawoo Plates window back
- It no longer says the design was applied; the game only takes picks made in its own menus
